anchors.name: Evangelical
anchors.description: Emphasizes conversion, biblical authority, and the necessity of a personal relationship with Christ.

anchors.name: Catholic
anchors.description: Emphasizes sacraments, apostolic succession, the magisterium, and the communion of saints.

anchors.name: Orthodox
anchors.description: Emphasizes theosis, liturgical tradition, the consensus of the fathers, and icons.

anchors.name: Anglican
anchors.description: Balances scripture, tradition, and reason within a prayer-formed life.

anchors.name: Mainline Protestant
anchors.description: Emphasizes social justice, theological scholarship, and ecumenical cooperation.

anchors.name: Baptist
anchors.description: Emphasizes believer's baptism, congregational autonomy, and the authority of scripture.

anchors.name: Pentecostal
anchors.description: Emphasizes the baptism of the Holy Spirit, gifts of the Spirit, and a vibrant worship life.

anchors.name: Reformed
anchors.description: Emphasizes the sovereignty of God, the primacy of grace, and the regulative principle of worship.

anchors.name: Methodist
anchors.description: Emphasizes holiness, social action, and the pursuit of perfect love.

anchors.name: Non-Denominational
anchors.description: Emphasizes the core gospel without institutional baggage, often contemporary in style.

anchors.name: Presbyterian
anchors.description: Emphasizes representative eldership and the subordinate standard of the Westminster Confession.

anchors.name: Lutheran
anchors.description: Emphasizes justification by faith alone, the sacraments, and the Book of Concord.
